task.description: Hard gate: review the DDL-05/MIG-01/MIG-02/MIG-03 implementation against docs/agents/instructions/security-invariants.md. This is a tenant-data-path change: new migration creating a cross-tenant platform.platform_migrations table, a cross-tenant fanout loop opening connections to every tenant schema (src/platform/migration_fanout.zig), and a namespace-reservation check governing what tenants can create inside their own schema (src/platform/ddl_namespace.zig). Check tenant data isolation (does the fanout correctly scope each tenant DDL step to that tenant only, no cross-tenant leakage), SQL parameterization (no string interpolation), and any new-path scoping proof required for a cross-tenant admin operation.
acceptance_criteria: Every numbered security invariant in security-invariants.md checked against the diff
Tenant data isolation verified for the fanout loop (per-tenant connection/search_path scoping)
No catch unreachable on realistic DB failure paths

result.summary: Security review of DDL-05/MIG-01/MIG-02/MIG-03 (commits d1a42070, 8dbe25e3). APPLIES and PASS: INV-1 (tenant data isolation) - platform.platform_migrations lives in a dedicated non-public, non-tenant 'platform' schema, correctly schema-qualified per the documented exception; migration_fanout.zig's applyToTenant() acquires a fresh connection per tenant, sets SET LOCAL search_path (transaction-scoped, cleared on COMMIT/ROLLBACK) to exactly one tenant schema before running the caller-supplied DDL step in the same transaction, then releases the connection via defer - no cross-tenant leakage path found; lint_migration_schema.py and lint_sql_table_refs.py both exit 0 with 0 violations. INV-7 (no SQL string interpolation) - all variable SQL content (migration_id, tenant_id, run_id, error_msg) uses $N placeholders (seedPendingRow, markDone, recordFailureSeparately, acquireMigrationLock/releaseMigrationLock); the one std.fmt.bufPrint use builds 'SET LOCAL search_path TO {schema_name},public', which is the codebase-wide established pattern (identical in src/db/pool.zig, src/db/migrations.zig, src/event_store/store.zig) because Postgres SET does not accept bind parameters, and schema_name is derived by schemaNameForTenant() from a validated UUID (hyphens stripped) or the fixed literal 'tenant_default', not raw tenant-supplied text; lint_sql_param_types.py exits 0/0/0. INV-8 (no catch unreachable on realistic failure paths) - zero catch-unreachable occurrences in the diff's .zig files; every DB call (BEGIN/SET LOCAL/step/UPDATE/COMMIT/acquire) uses typed catch blocks that roll back and record failure via recordFailureSeparately/logSwallowedFailure rather than panicking. INV-6 (new data-access path proves its scoping) - satisfied by this review itself; migration_fanout.zig/ddl_namespace.zig are library functions with no HTTP route caller yet (grep confirms no src/api/routes reference), which is expected at this stage per the task brief and not itself a defect - their internal scoping (per-migration_id advisory lock, per-tenant transaction boundary) is sound independent of the caller; the future MIG-06 HTTP endpoint will still need its own platform-admin role gate at the route layer, noted as a forward-looking build note, not a finding against this diff. NOT APPLICABLE: INV-2 (no API response struct changed), INV-3 (no Lua/Wasm host-API touched), INV-4 (no secret material - grep for client_secret/SecretRef/sec:// in the new files returns nothing), INV-5 (no lookup-by-ID HTTP handler added).
